acceptance.authoritative_configuration: Exact input bytes preserved. Existing open loads persisted bytes or fails an exact expected-byte mismatch; strict schema/source-set checks never reset data. Configuration/provider tokens bind random incarnation plus exact-byte SHA.
acceptance.ownership: Real flock refusal in same process and child process. Controlled child commits, is force-killed, and reopened cache retains exact raw, rotates owner token, and remains inactive. Cloneable one-controller coordinator; drop test holds worker and proves caller does not join while lock remains owned.
acceptance.controller_only_admission: Refresh creates its own core attempt and durably registers request ID before provider fetch. No arbitrary FeedSourceRead or JSON condition accepted as write permit. Both provider adapters cache descriptor outside storage worker; actual fetch callback reentry is tested.
acceptance.cancellation: Bounded16 queued plus1 running storage worker separate from network executor. Canceled callers do not free queue capacity while queued closures remain. SQLite busy_handler signals actual BEGIN IMMEDIATE BUSY under external lock before dropping config/provider/activation futures; final canceled check prevents their mutations. Rust Future-drop cancellation only; no Swift Task.cancel claim.
acceptance.executor_isolation: All4 actual public-network blocking slots occupied by controlled closures that signal entry and wait for explicit cleanup release. Offline normalization/config SQLite operations complete on dedicated storage worker. This is DNS-equivalent executor saturation, not an actual DNS qualification.
acceptance.conditional_304: Actual retained bytes are loaded and SHA-verified inside same final SQLite transaction, under opaque core guarded commit. Missing/evicted/corrupt/body/context/profile/cache-token and valid-but-different full-context cases refuse; empty incoming304 body never replaces retained raw.
acceptance.commit_outcomes: Actual successful SQLite COMMIT followed by injected acknowledgment failure reconciles exact receipt and full candidate row using one fresh read-connection transaction snapshot. Separate postcommit profile mutation and unreadable-reconciliation faults close uncertain. Precommit injection rolls back; no blind replay or false rollback claim.
acceptance.disk_full: Actual SQLite max_page_count constraint induces FULL on larger valid feed insert, retaining prior committed raw. Then query_only=true rejects every SQL write while offline revalidation/display still succeeds. Disk is not intentionally filled.
acceptance.offline: Revalidate source/provider/URL/format/fullcontext/rawSHA/profile and re-normalize original bytes; final read transaction rechecks owner/config/cache/context/token. No recency UPDATE or implicit network. Corruption is per-source error; no generic corruption-to-fetch fallback.
acceptance.explicit_edits: Reviewed configuration CAS atomically evicts raw+receipt only for removed or URL/format-changed source IDs. Cosmetic/enabled changes retain valid cache. Different provider ID replacement evicts incompatible rows; same-ID executable replacement can retain context-valid raw. Injected failed lifecycle transactions retain prior rows.
acceptance.quota: 64MiB logical retained raw+metadata and max128 current rows. Actual byte-length/type accounting rejects forged negative/underreported/overflow values; max-row test uses lower private test threshold to exercise same eviction algorithm. Eviction excludes admitted candidate and follows successful admission/refresh recency, not offline read-access LRU. This is not a physical SQLite/WAL disk cap.
acceptance.view_identity_dates: Unique per-source variant keys hash schema/profile/sourceID/stable canonical entry fields, excluding first ordinal, duplicate count and conflict marker. Reorder/duplicate stability and conflicting native-ID variants tested. Published and updated remain independent; missing/invalid/pre-epoch/leap representation preserved. Published parsed(seconds,nanos) sorts lexicographically newest-first; undated ties retain source ordinal. No fetch/check timestamp sorting fallback.

api.type: Rust-native FeedCacheController (not UniFFI-exported in this checkpoint)
api.synchronous_boundary: Constructors perform local filesystem I/O and must run off UI. They are offline and inactive. Existing descriptor must match persisted provider; constructor does not overwrite it.
api.close_drop: close acknowledges after worker DB/owner-lock release. Drop never joins; worker drains/cancels queued jobs then closes. Reopen refuses while old worker still owns lock.
api.revisions: Public feed revision values remain strictly validated raw JSON, never cast to SQLite signed counters. Internal ordering counters checked on increment.
api.authority: Host-local cache/activation only, no Castalia/vault identity or private Desk authority.
